audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags the exact contradiction: content win[] already says Brand wins all 7 stages, but full-layer phases[N].side is the unfilled template value 'Skill' on every row, not 'Brand'. The two layers disagree.
audit.why: content.win[] is grounded in the matchup's real mechanics (Brand's ranged poke, Q-stun-on-Ablaze, Liandry's spike, AoE late-game burst) matching the enemy kit; phases[].side/.why are the generic Leona-favored template ('E-Q online', 'Solar Flare online' etc.) that was never customized for this matchup. win[N] is already the side to move to, so per the chart rule this needs side+why edited together in the full layer, with win[] left alone (it's already correct).
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side changed from 'Skill' to 'Brand'; phases[0..6].why rewritten to state the Brand-favored reason at each stage, mirroring content.whys/early/mid/late.

audit.whatIsWrong: content spikes already name real power spikes (lvl2 Ablaze-Q stun, lvl6 Pyroclasm/Q-detonate, 1st item Liandry's, late AoE burst).
audit.why: Matches enemyKit — Q only stuns Ablazed targets, R bounces to stack Blaze, Liandry's/Blackfire Torch are real DoT items.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit (lint); dosFull[1]/dontsFull[2] are copy-paste bleed from tradeGood/tradeBad, and tradeGood/tradeBad themselves are the same generic engage-mirror template shared with every other matchup in this brief batch, ungrounded in Brand's actual poke/DoT kit.
audit.why: Brand's Q Sear is 8s down to 6s at rank 5 and only stuns an already-Ablazed target; his R Pyroclasm is 100/90/80s and bounces to stack Blaze to max on champions.
audit.corrected: See edits: breakdown.cooldowns, tradeGood, tradeBad rewritten with real mechanics/numbers; dosFull[1]/dontsFull[2] rewritten to match their own titles instead of duplicating tradeGood/tradeBad.

edits.before: Auto-trade behind passive marks — your carry's follow-up hits harder than the lane reads.
edits.after: His W-E poke outranges every trade you offer, and once you're Ablazed his Q becomes a stun punishing any approach.

edits.before: E-Q online — the chain is live and the lane's geometry answers to your blade.
edits.after: Ablaze lets his Q stun your E dash before you can lock him — poke still governs this stage.

edits.before: Full chain: E-Q-W locks a carry for the full duo rotation; pick the window.
edits.after: Ranked W and his stacking passive widen a poke lead you can't answer by walking up.

edits.before: Zone with chain threat — their carry farms where your E says.
edits.after: Q-stun threat and burst zone you off farm and force a bad approach every time.

edits.before: Solar Flare online — dives start from two screens and the sun votes center-stun.
edits.after: Pyroclasm plus his Q-detonate can lock and burst you through your own R dash.

edits.before: First item: the chain hardens and every landed E is a kill.
edits.after: Liandry's shreds you through your shield the moment you mistime an engage.

edits.before: Late Leona starts everything: flare the entry, chain the carry, eclipse the answer.
edits.after: His AoE burst and spreading passive outscale your single-target lockdown in every fight.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns the ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Eclipse answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Brand Q (8s down to 6s at rank 5): only stuns an Ablazed target — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Eclipse answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - His R (100/90/80s) bounces to stack Blaze — spend your own R before his is up.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Trade only once he's spent Sear — a landed stun chains into full burst, so bait it out before you step up.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Walking into W-E range while Ablazed feeds his Q stun — back off until it clears or eat the burst.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Brand's W-E lose value the farther out you stand — hold max range and only step up once Sear is down.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Answering ranged poke with a melee step just eats more W-E — disengage and wait for your jungler instead.
